blockingIssues.problem: The idea targets “Aquarium managers evaluating whether the trial should continue,” but the source frames the note as communication to visitors and explicitly states it is not a staff evaluation. The source does not assign the note to managers or indicate it was intended to inform managerial decisions.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: “This note is for aquarium visitors whose booked tide-pool session is cancelled.” … “The note helps affected visitors adapt their visit; it is not a staff evaluation.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The source assigns the communication to affected visitors and disclaims that it is not a staff evaluation; the idea cannot repurpose the note as a management-facing evaluation without additional evidence.

blockingIssues.category: Insufficient evidence to support managerial evaluation
blockingIssues.problem: The idea implies the trial provides evidence managers could use to decide whether to continue it, but the source lacks outcome data. Staff did not record whether visitors completed the trail or were satisfied, so there is no basis in the source to evaluate the trial’s effectiveness or justify continuation.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: “At two trial openings 26 cards were handed out. Staff did not record completion or satisfaction.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The source provides only counts of cards handed out and explicitly reports no records of completion or satisfaction; it does not supply outcome or satisfaction data that would support an evaluation of the trial’s success or a decision to continue it.
